A bright unidentified object above the airport led authorities to close Xiaoshan and divert flights for about an hour.

**Explanation:** Chinese UFO research groups found no radar images and concluded the object was probably an aircraft, possibly military.

## Montevideo — the photo from the national team’s homecoming (2010)

- Date: 13 July 2010 (time approximate)
- Place: Palacio Legislativo and Avenida del Libertador, Montevideo (Uruguay)
- Status: EXPLAINED — Mundane explanation widely accepted or officially assessed
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Photographs; Official government document or case file
- Shape: A semicircular object in the sky
- Witnesses: Fans who photographed the celebration; no direct witness of the object came forward
- Duration: Unknown (found in photographs)
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/montevideo-celeste-2010/

On July 13, 2010, huge crowds met Uruguay’s football team at the Palacio Legislativo in Montevideo after its fourth place at the World Cup. One fan’s photograph, and others taken at the same spot, showed a semicircular object in the sky, and the picture spread as a UFO. The Uruguayan Air Force’s commission for UFO reports, CRIDOVNI, examined it and reported on July 28: it put the chance of fraud by the photographer or anyone else, and of a psychological effect, at zero, but gave a 97% probability to a conventional object, something like a piece of nylon, paper or cloth lifted by the rising air currents over Avenida del Libertador. No one who had seen the object itself came forward.

**Explanation:** The Uruguayan Air Force’s commission CRIDOVNI found the photographs genuine but rated a conventional cause 97% likely: a light object such as nylon, paper or cloth carried up by rising air over the avenue, with no one having seen anything at the time.

Sources:
- [Montevideo Portal — “Informe de Fuerza Aérea niega ovni” (July 28, 2010)](https://www.montevideo.com.uy/Noticias/Informe-de-Fuerza-Aerea-niega-ovni-uc115375)

## El Bosque Air Base — the object in the air-show video (2010)

- Date: 5 November 2010 (time approximate)
- Place: El Bosque Air Base, Santiago (Chile)
- Status: DISPUTED — Explanation proposed but contested
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Official government document or case file; Many independent witnesses
- Shape: A small dark object darting past the jets
- Witnesses: Spectators at an air show who filmed it; nobody saw the object at the time
- Duration: A fraction of a second per pass
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/el-bosque-2010/

On the morning of November 5, 2010, the Chilean Air Force held a change-of-command ceremony with an air show at El Bosque Air Base in Santiago, with the Halcones aerobatic team, F-5s and F-16s. An engineer from the nearby aircraft factory, reviewing his own video in slow motion, noticed a small object that seemed to loop near the jets, and handed it to CEFAA, the committee of the civil aviation directorate that studies aerial phenomena. CEFAA gathered seven videos from different spectators and, at a press conference on March 13, 2012, said an astronomer had ruled out a meteoroid, space debris, a bird and an aircraft, estimated the object’s speed at over 6,500 km/h and said the incident could not be explained scientifically. Nobody at the show had noticed anything. Critics pointed out that the speed holds only if the object was far away; analyses of the original frames by the HoaxKiller project and others found the shape and motion of an insect a few metres from the lens.

**Explanation:** Chile’s aerial-phenomena committee CEFAA said the object could not be explained and estimated a speed of thousands of km/h, which depends entirely on an assumed distance. Independent analysts, among them the HoaxKiller project and the neurologist Steven Novella, showed that the frames match an insect flying close to the camera, which nobody present would have noticed.

Sources:
- [Leslie Kean — UFO caught on tape over Santiago air base (HuffPost, 2012)](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/the-extraordinary-ufo-sig_b_1342585)
- [Steven Novella — UFO over Chilean air base (NeuroLogica, 2012)](https://theness.com/neurologicablog/ufo-over-chilean-air-base/)
- [Kloptdatwel — the Chilean UFO video has six legs (2012)](https://kloptdatwel.nl/2012/03/22/ufo-video-uit-chili-bewijst-t-ze-hebben-zes-pootjes/)

## The “mystery missile” off Los Angeles — an airliner’s contrail (2010)

- Date: 8 November 2010
- Place: Over the Pacific about 35 miles west of Los Angeles, north of Santa Catalina Island (United States)
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Official government document or case file; Radar tracking
- Shape: A thick, glowing vapour trail apparently rising from the sea, with a bright head
- Witnesses: A KCBS news-helicopter crew; many people in the Los Angeles area
- Duration: Minutes, at sunset
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/california-contrail-2010/

At about 5:15 p.m. on November 8, 2010, a KCBS news helicopter filmed what looked like a missile climbing from the sea about 35 miles west of Los Angeles, a thick vapour trail glowing orange against the sunset with a bright point at its head. The footage ran on every network as the “mystery missile”, and for a day and a half nobody official could say what it was: the Pentagon said it was not a Defense Department launch, NORAD and Northern Command said it was no foreign military launch and no threat, the Navy said it was not theirs, and the FAA had approved no commercial launch. Contrail specialists and the analyst John Pike said at once that it was an aircraft contrail seen end-on, the head of the trail moving far too slowly for a rocket; the FAA’s radar replays found no fast unknown target, and on November 10 the Pentagon said there was “no evidence to suggest that this is anything else other than a condensation trail from an aircraft.” NASA researchers later found the trail on the GOES-11 weather-satellite image as a long horizontal streak. A few experts said they could not rule out a missile, but the incident is now a textbook example of foreshortened perspective.

**Explanation:** A condensation trail from an airliner flying towards the camera, which made a horizontal trail look like a vertical column lit by the setting sun. The FAA’s radar replays found no fast unidentified target, the Pentagon said there was no evidence it was anything else, and NASA’s contrail specialists found the trail on GOES-11 satellite imagery as a horizontal streak. US Airways Flight 808 from Honolulu and UPS Flight 902 were named as candidates.

Sources:
- [NASA — Mystery contrail spotted in satellite imagery](https://web.archive.org/web/20101117092533/https://www.nasa.gov/topics/earth/features/mystery-contrail.html)
- [Reuters — Mystery vapor trail not likely from missile: Pentagon](https://www.reuters.com/article/world/us-politics/mystery-vapor-trail-not-likely-from-missile-pentagon-idUSTRE6A83Z8/)
- [Contrail Science — the Los Angeles “missile” contrail explained in pictures](https://contrailscience.com/los-angeles-missile-contrail-explained-in-pictures/)
- [Wikipedia — 2010 California contrail incident](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2010_California_contrail_incident)

## The light over the Dome of the Rock (hoax) (2011)

- Date: 28 January 2011 (time approximate)
- Place: Dome of the Rock, Temple Mount (Haram al-Sharif), Old City of Jerusalem
- Status: EXPLAINED — Mundane explanation widely accepted or officially assessed
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Video / film footage
- Shape: A bright white light that descends, hovers over the dome, flashes and shoots straight up
- Witnesses: The anonymous uploaders of four videos; no independent witness
- Duration: Under a minute
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/jerusalem-temple-mount-2011/

In late January 2011 a YouTube video appeared showing a small bright light dropping slowly toward the Dome of the Rock some time after midnight on January 28, hovering just above the golden dome, flashing, and then shooting straight up out of sight. A second clip from another angle followed, then two more, posted under the challenge “Have fun debunking this one”. The videos went round the world, with commentators noting that the multiple viewpoints made them hard to dismiss. Within days investigators pointed to the anonymous sources, the lack of any other witness in one of the most watched places on Earth, the missing reflection on the dome and signs of editing, and the case became a standard example of a digitally inserted UFO.

**Explanation:** The videos were faked. They were posted anonymously; nobody else among the many people in and around the Old City reported the light; it casts no reflection on the gilded dome; one clip was filmed off a monitor screen; and the analyst Robert Sheaffer showed that the camera shake had been added with an edge-mirroring “motion tile” effect. Nobody has owned up, but no one who examined the clips found them genuine.

Sources:
- [Space.com — Hoax in the Holy Land: Jerusalem UFO a proven fake](https://www.space.com/10789-jerusalem-ufo-hoax.html)
- [Village Voice — Jerusalem UFO videos a hoax](https://www.villagevoice.com/?p=238594)
- [NPR — A UFO over Jerusalem? Only if you believe in those sorts of things](https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2011/02/04/133493963/a-ufo-over-jerusalem-only-if-you-believe-in-those-sorts-things)

## Santiago — the silver spheres over the Paseo Bulnes (2012)

- Date: 11 May 2012 (time approximate)
- Place: Paseo Bulnes, central Santiago (Chile)
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Mass sighting
- Evidence: Many independent witnesses; Photographs; Video / film footage
- Shape: Six bright silvery spheres
- Witnesses: Hundreds of people in the centre of Santiago
- Duration: Hours, until the explanation came
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/santiago-balloons-2012/

On Friday, May 11, 2012, hundreds of people in the centre of Santiago stopped to watch a group of six bright, silvery spheres in the sky. Photographs and videos spread under the hashtag #OvnisEnStgo, and the sighting became a national talking point within hours. The same day it emerged that the spheres were silver helium balloons released from the Paseo Bulnes by students of the Universidad Mayor’s school of architecture, as an installation in a competition between four student groups intended to screen the view towards the La Moneda palace.

**Explanation:** The objects were silver helium balloons released from the Paseo Bulnes by architecture students of the Universidad Mayor, one of four groups in a school competition; the installation was meant to block the view of La Moneda.

Sources:
- [24 Horas — the balloons that frightened Santiago](https://www.24horas.cl/tendencias/espectaculosycultura/los-globos-que-asustaron-a-santiago-132004)
- [El Dínamo — the collective psychosis over #OvnisEnStgo (May 11, 2012)](https://www.eldinamo.cl/redes/2012/05/11/asi-fue-la-sicosis-colectiva-por-los-ovnisenstgo/)

## Ladakh lights — the “Chinese drones” that were planets (2012)

- Date: 1 August 2012 (time approximate)
- Place: Thakung post, near Pangong Tso, eastern Ladakh, India
- Status: EXPLAINED — Mundane explanation widely accepted or officially assessed
- Kind: Recurring lights
- Evidence: Military witnesses; Many independent witnesses
- Shape: Yellowish luminous spheres rising from the horizon on the Chinese side
- Witnesses: Indian Army and Indo-Tibetan Border Police troops
- Duration: August 2012 to February 2013; hours each night
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/ladakh-lights-2012/

From August 2012, soldiers and border police on the Line of Actual Control in eastern Ladakh reported luminous objects rising over the Chinese side and staying up for hours. With Chinese drones a real concern, the army logged 329 sightings by February 2013 and counted 155 apparent violations of the border. At the army’s request, two astronomers from the Indian Institute of Astrophysics in Bengaluru travelled to Thakung, near Pangong Tso, and measured the objects with a theodolite: one was visible from about 6 p.m. to 5 a.m., the other from about 4 a.m., and they moved with the stars. They were Jupiter and Venus. A soldier’s note that one object rose about four minutes earlier every day, as a planet does, had already pointed the same way.

**Explanation:** Astronomers of the Indian Institute of Astrophysics, sent at the army’s request, identified the two brightest “objects” as Jupiter and Venus, made unusually bright by the altitude; their apparent motion was the sky turning. The defence minister told Parliament there was no conclusive proof of UFOs.

Sources:
- [The Register — Indian army mistook Jupiter and Venus for Chinese spy drones (2013)](https://www.theregister.com/2013/07/26/india_china_war_jupiter_mars_drones/)
- [IBTimes India — Army spends six months tracking “Chinese spy drones” that were planets (2013)](https://www.ibtimes.co.in/mistaken-identity-indian-army-spends-6-months-tracking-039chinese-spy-drones039-but-finds-they-were-planets-495172)

## Chelyabinsk meteor — and the “UFO that shot it down” (2013)

- Date: 15 February 2013
- Place: Chelyabinsk Oblast, Russia; the air burst south of Chelyabinsk
- Status: EXPLAINED — Mundane explanation widely accepted or officially assessed
- Kind: Tracked object event
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Many independent witnesses; Physical traces (ground marks, debris, soil); Documented physiological effects; Infrared or other sensor data
- Shape: A fireball brighter than the Sun, leaving a long, twisted smoke trail
- Witnesses: Hundreds of thousands in Chelyabinsk Oblast and neighbouring regions; filmed by hundreds of dashboard and security cameras
- Duration: About 15 seconds of flight; the shock wave arrived one to three minutes later
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/chelyabinsk-2013/

At 9:20 a.m. on February 15, 2013, a fireball brighter than the Sun crossed the morning sky of the southern Urals from the east and exploded south of Chelyabinsk, leaving a smoke trail tens of kilometres long. A minute or more later the shock wave blew in windows across the city: 1,491 people sought medical help, most cut by glass, and more than 7,000 buildings were damaged. Because Russian drivers routinely run dashboard cameras, the event was filmed from hundreds of angles, which let scientists reconstruct its path and orbit within days. Within hours, too, clips circulated claiming that a small object had flown into the meteor and shattered it, and the UFO commentator Gennady Belimov said a UFO had shot it down; a survey by the newspaper Noviye Izvestia found barely half its readers accepted the official account. The fragments in museum collections are ordinary chondrite.

**Explanation:** A near-Earth asteroid about 20 m across entered at about 19 km/s at a shallow angle and exploded some 30 km up with the energy of roughly 400–500 kilotons of TNT, recorded by infrasound stations worldwide and by U.S. government sensors. Meteorites were collected across the strewn field, and a 654 kg fragment was raised from Lake Chebarkul in October 2013. Claims that videos showed a UFO destroying the meteor, and a newspaper survey in which many readers preferred a weapon test or a crashing alien ship, rest on nothing but the footage of the meteor itself.

Sources:
- [Wikipedia — Chelyabinsk meteor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chelyabinsk_meteor)
- [Christian Science Monitor — Was Chelyabinsk meteor actually a meteor? Many Russians don’t think so](https://www.csmonitor.com/Science/2013/0222/Was-Chelyabinsk-meteor-actually-a-meteor-Many-Russians-don-t-think-so)

## Collahuasi mine — CEFAA’s “UFO” photographs (2013)

- Date: 15 April 2013 (time approximate)
- Place: Collahuasi copper mine, 4,300 m up in the Tarapacá Andes (Chile)
- Status: UNRESOLVED — No accepted explanation
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Photographs; Official government document or case file; Many independent witnesses
- Shape: A silver disc, estimated 5 to 10 m across
- Witnesses: Four technicians at the mine (anonymous); the photographs reached CEFAA through the chief engineer
- Duration: More than an hour
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/collahuasi-2013/

On a clear day in mid-April 2013, four technicians at the Collahuasi copper mine, high in the Andes of northern Chile, watched a silver disc hover silently for more than an hour at what they estimated as about 600 m, and one of them took photographs with a compact camera. They kept quiet until the mine’s chief engineer sent two pictures to CEFAA in February 2014. A CEFAA analyst at the meteorological office ruled out lenticular cloud, aircraft, drones, balloons and birds, found the object brighter than reflected sunlight would make it, and concluded it “can be qualified as a UFO”; the director, retired General Ricardo Bermúdez, released the study in July 2014 but said it was one analyst’s view and that the committee had to be cautious. The witnesses never answered CEFAA’s requests to talk, the originals and the order of the pictures were uncertain, and critics noted that a disc against blue sky gives no way to judge its size or distance. CEFAA filed the case as unexplained.

Sources:
- [Leslie Kean — Chile releases official study on UFO photos (HuffPost, 2014)](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/government-agency-in-chil_b_5558713)
- [Noticias Caracol — Chilean aeronautics confirms a UFO sighting (2014)](https://www.noticiascaracol.com/mundo/aeronautica-chilena-confirmo-avistamiento-de-un-ovni)
- [Kloptdatwel — critique of the CEFAA analysis (2014)](https://kloptdatwel.nl/2014/07/09/chileens-ufo-bureau-weet-t-weer-eens-niet/)

## Aguadilla thermal video (DHS) (2013)

- Date: 25 April 2013
- Place: Rafael Hernández Airport, Aguadilla, Puerto Rico (Puerto Rico (U.S.))
- Status: EXPLAINED — Mundane explanation widely accepted or officially assessed
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Infrared or other sensor data; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Small hot object; appears to enter and exit the sea
- Witnesses: U.S. Customs and Border Protection aircrew; tower controllers
- Duration: ~3 minutes of video
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/aguadilla-2013/

A Customs and Border Protection DHC-8 recorded a small, hot object crossing the airport and heading out over the ocean, where it appeared to plunge into the water and re-emerge. The leaked video became a staple of UAP analysis; AARO published a 3D reconstruction video in 2025.

**Explanation:** AARO assesses with high confidence the objects showed no anomalous speed or behaviour: a reconstruction of the sensor’s look angle shows two objects travelling near each other in a straight line at wind speed, never entering the water. Its case resolution assesses with moderate confidence that they were a pair of sky lanterns. Some independent analysts still dispute this.

Sources:
- [AARO case resolution: Puerto Rico UAP](https://www.aaro.mil/Portals/136/PDFs/case_resolution_reports/AARO_Puerto_Rico_UAP_Case_Resolution.pdf)

## Naga fireballs of the Mekong (2013)

- Date: 19 October 2013
- Place: The Mekong around Phon Phisai and Nong Khai, Thailand, and the Lao bank opposite
- Status: DISPUTED — Explanation proposed but contested
- Kind: Recurring lights
- Evidence: Photographs; Video / film footage; Many independent witnesses
- Shape: Reddish-pink balls of light rising silently from the river to a few hundred metres
- Witnesses: Tens of thousands of festival visitors each year
- Duration: Seconds each; tens to thousands a night, on the night of Ok Phansa
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/naga-fireballs/

Every year on the night of Wan Ok Phansa, the full moon that ends the Buddhist Rains Retreat in October, crowds gather along a 250 km stretch of the Mekong centred on Phon Phisai to watch glowing reddish balls rise silently from the water, climb a few hundred metres and vanish. Local belief credits the phaya nak, the serpent said to live in the river; until the mid-1980s they were called ghost lights, and the Phayanak festival now draws tens of thousands of visitors. The photograph here was taken near Nong Khai on Ok Phansa night, 2013. Sceptics point to gunfire and flares from the Lao bank, which the crowds would not hear across the river; believers point out that the lights also appear over ponds and smaller rivers away from the border.

**Explanation:** In 2002 a documentary on Thailand’s iTV filmed Lao soldiers on the far bank firing tracer rounds into the air during the festival, and the Thai biologist Jessada Denduangboripant, after studying footage, concluded the lights were flares fired from the other side. Neither explanation is accepted locally, and a Lao government inquiry in 2021, held during a COVID-19 curfew with police on the river, said it was “extremely unlikely” anyone could have fired unnoticed. The idea of phosphine or methane from the riverbed has no scientific support.

Sources:
- [Wikipedia — Naga fireball](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naga_fireball)

## Chilean Navy helicopter FLIR video (2014)

- Date: 11 November 2014
- Place: Coast between San Antonio and Quinteros, Chile
- Status: DISPUTED — Explanation proposed but contested
- Kind: Military encounter
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Infrared or other sensor data; Military witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Flat, elongated object with two hot discharges
- Witnesses: Navy helicopter crew (pilot and camera operator)
- Duration: More than 10 minutes
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/chile-navy-2014/

On November 11, 2014 a Chilean Navy helicopter on coastal patrol west of Santiago, at about 4,500 feet, picked up an unknown object on its high-definition infrared camera. The two-man crew also saw it with the naked eye for more than ten minutes. The captain described a flat, elongated object with two thermal discharges that did not line up with its direction of travel, and the video shows what looks like a chemical plume. The Navy’s aerial-phenomena office CEFAA examined it and later released the footage, saying it could not be sure what it was. Sceptics later said the images match the contrail of a distant aircraft.

**Explanation:** Chile’s aerial-phenomena office (CEFAA) left the case open because it could not be certain of the object’s nature. Later analyses by sceptics proposed an aircraft’s contrail and exhaust seen by infrared as the likely cause.

Sources:
- [The War Zone — The Chilean military has no idea what this flying object is](https://www.twz.com/6852/the-chilean-military-has-no-idea-what-this-flying-object-is)

## USS Theodore Roosevelt — Gimbal & GoFast (2015)

- Date: 21 January 2015 (time approximate)
- Place: Atlantic warning areas off Jacksonville, Florida (International waters (U.S. East Coast))
- Status: DISPUTED — Explanation proposed but contested
- Kind: Military encounter
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Infrared or other sensor data; Radar tracking; Pilot / aircrew witnesses; Military witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Rotating lozenge (Gimbal); small fast object (GoFast)
- Witnesses: VFA-11 aircrew; Lt. Ryan Graves’ squadron reported near-daily objects
- Duration: Seconds of video; months of sightings
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/gimbal-gofast-2015/

In 2014–2015 F/A-18F crews of the Roosevelt strike group reported frequent unknown objects on their upgraded APG-79 radars off the East Coast. Two ATFLIR clips — "Gimbal", with a crew member exclaiming about "a whole fleet of them", and "GoFast", a small object skimming over the ocean — were released by the Pentagon in April 2020.

**Explanation:** Both videos were officially released and remain "unidentified" per DoD. Analysts such as Mick West argue GoFast shows a slow object (e.g. a balloon) at ~13,000 ft that only looks fast and low because of parallax, and that Gimbal’s rotation is a glare artifact of the ATFLIR pod. AARO later published a case resolution for GoFast worked out from the sensor’s geometry and the winds aloft.

Sources:
- [DoD statement on the release of historical Navy videos (Apr 2020)](https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/2165713/statement-by-the-department-of-defense-on-the-release-of-historical-navy-videos/)
- [AARO case resolution: GoFast](https://www.aaro.mil/Portals/136/PDFs/case_resolution_reports/AARO_GoFast_Case_Resolution_Card_Methodology_Final.pdf)

## The light over California — a Trident II test from USS Kentucky (2015)

- Date: 7 November 2015 (time approximate)
- Place: The Navy’s Pacific Test Range off Southern California; seen from California, Nevada and Arizona (United States)
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Tracked object event
- Evidence: Many independent witnesses; Photographs; Video / film footage; Official government document or case file
- Shape: A bright light trailing a glowing, expanding cone of blue-white vapour
- Witnesses: Thousands of people from San Francisco to San Diego, Las Vegas and Phoenix
- Duration: Several minutes
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/trident-launch-2015/

Shortly after 6 p.m. on Saturday, November 7, 2015, a bright light rose over the Pacific west of Los Angeles and grew into a glowing, spreading cone of vapour that was seen from the Bay Area to San Diego and as far as Nevada and Arizona. Police and sheriff’s offices across Southern California were flooded with calls, and the videos spread across social media as a UFO, a meteor or a missile gone wrong. The Navy said that evening that its Strategic Systems Programs had carried out a scheduled test flight of an unarmed Trident II D5 missile from USS Kentucky in the Pacific Test Range; such launches are not announced in advance. The effect, sunlight catching the exhaust plume high above a darkened ground, is the same as the Iridium launch of 2017 and many Vandenberg twilight launches before it.

**Explanation:** An unarmed Trident II (D5) ballistic missile fired by the submarine USS Kentucky during a scheduled test in the Pacific Test Range. The Navy confirmed it the same evening; its exhaust plume, lit by sunlight high above the darkened ground, produced the expanding “twilight phenomenon”.

Sources:
- [NPR — California: That strange light streaking across the sky was no UFO](https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/11/08/455204983/california-that-strange-light-streaking-across-the-sky-was-no-ufo)
- [NBC News — Missile test off California coast causes streaking-light confusion](https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/missile-test-calif-coast-causes-streaking-light-confusion-n459356)

## Fireball over the West — a Chinese rocket stage re-entering (2016)

- Date: 27 July 2016
- Place: Across California, Nevada and Utah (United States)
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Tracked object event
- Evidence: Many independent witnesses; Video / film footage; Official government document or case file
- Shape: A slow procession of bright fragments with glowing trails
- Witnesses: Thousands of people in California, Nevada, Utah, Idaho and Colorado
- Duration: More than 30 seconds in view from most places
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/long-march-reentry-2016/

At about 9:36 p.m. on July 27, 2016, a slow procession of bright fragments with long trails crossed the sky over California, Nevada and Utah, seen from Los Angeles to Las Vegas and Salt Lake City and filmed by many people. It moved far more slowly than a meteor. Within hours the Joint Space Operations Center at Vandenberg confirmed that it had tracked the re-entry of the spent second stage of China’s new Long March 7 rocket, launched a month earlier, and later removed the object from the satellite catalogue as decayed. The astronomer Jonathan McDowell identified the stage from the tracking data. Like the Zond IV fragments of 1968, it is the kind of event that turns into a “formation of craft” in some witnesses’ descriptions.

**Explanation:** The Joint Space Operations Center confirmed that the objects were the second stage of China’s Long March 7 rocket, launched on its first flight on June 25, 2016, re-entering the atmosphere and breaking up.

Sources:
- [Vandenberg Air Force Base — Joint Space Operations Center tracks re-entry over California](https://www.vandenberg.spaceforce.mil/News/Article-Display/Article/879445/joint-space-operations-center-tracks-reentry-over-california/)
- [EarthSky — Spectacular rocket re-entry over U.S. West](https://earthsky.org/human-world/spectacular-rocket-reentry-over-us-west/)

## Jeffreys Bay — a cargo crew’s green light (2016)

- Date: 12 December 2016
- Place: About 10 nautical miles off Jeffreys Bay, Eastern Cape (South Africa)
- Status: UNRESOLVED — No accepted explanation
- Kind: Aviation encounter
- Evidence: Pilot / aircrew witnesses
- Shape: A glowing green object
- Witnesses: The captain and first officer of a Boeing 737 freighter flying from Cape Town to Port Elizabeth
- Duration: Seconds
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/jeffreys-bay-2016/

At about 9:30 p.m. on December 12, 2016, the crew of a Boeing 737 cargo flight from Cape Town to Port Elizabeth, about 10 nautical miles off the coast at Jeffreys Bay, saw a glowing green object climb past the cockpit to the cloud layer some 1,000 feet above them, then turn and drop back past them toward the sea at high speed. Port Elizabeth air traffic control, fearing a vessel or aircraft in distress had fired a flare, asked the National Sea Rescue Institute to check; its Jeffreys Bay station watched overnight. The object was not seen again and no craft was overdue.

**Explanation:** A green parachute flare was suspected first and ruled out because a flare cannot climb that high; the NSRI found no vessel or aircraft overdue or missing. Green is the usual colour of a bright meteor, but a meteor does not climb, which is what the crew described. The NSRI called the incident “a mystery”.

Sources:
- [News24 — UFO spotted 1,000 feet in sky before hurtling towards earth: NSRI](https://www.news24.com/southafrica/news/ufo-spotted-1-000-feet-in-sky-before-hurtling-towards-earth-nsri-20161213)

## AARO’s “Southeast Asia Triangles” — fishing nets (2017)

- Date: 30 August 2017
- Place: A river in Southeast Asia (exact location withheld)
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Photographs; Infrared or other sensor data; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Six dark triangles in a line
- Witnesses: An intelligence analyst reviewing satellite imagery
- Duration: A single satellite image
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/southeast-asia-triangles-2017/

A commercial satellite image taken at 07:35 UTC on August 30, 2017 showed six dark triangles in a staggered line, and an intelligence analyst flagged them as possibly anomalous and a risk to navigation. AARO reviewed the case in 2023. Its partners found a clearer image of the same place from February 2017 that showed the triangles as cone-shaped fishing nets anchored in a river, all about 11 by 7 metres; later images from late 2022 and early 2023 showed the same shapes with turbidity trailing downstream, proving they were in the water, and stock footage showed such nets on that river. AARO closed the case as fishing nets. Its report names only “Southeast Asia”; the image’s time stamps, 07:35Z and 14:05 local, match Myanmar’s clock (UTC+6:30), and the marker is placed there only approximately.

**Explanation:** AARO, with intelligence and three science-and-technology partners, found “almost certainly” static, cone-shaped fishing nets on a river, each about 11 by 7 m, matched in other satellite images from 2017, 2022 and 2023 and in stock footage of the same river.

Sources:
- [AARO case resolution, “Southeast Asia Triangles” (copy at The Black Vault)](https://documents2.theblackvault.com/documents/dod/Southeast_Asia_Triangles_Case_Resolution.pdf)
- [The Black Vault — AARO releases three case resolution reports (2023)](https://www.theblackvault.com/documentarchive/aaro-releases-3-case-resolution-reports-identifying-uap-ufo-cases/)

## The Los Angeles “UFO” — SpaceX Iridium-4 launch (2017)

- Date: 22 December 2017
- Place: Vandenberg Air Force Base; seen across Southern California and as far as Arizona (United States)
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Mass sighting
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Photographs; Many independent witnesses
- Shape: A glowing, expanding jellyfish-like cloud with a bright point at its head
- Witnesses: Thousands across Southern California, Nevada and Arizona
- Duration: Several minutes
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/iridium-4-launch-2017/

At 5:27 p.m. on December 22, 2017, twenty minutes after sunset, a Falcon 9 lifted off from Space Launch Complex 4E at Vandenberg carrying ten Iridium NEXT satellites. High above the darkening ground the exhaust was still in sunlight, and the expanding plume, the staging and the fairing separation drew a luminous, jellyfish-like cloud seen from Los Angeles to Las Vegas and Phoenix. Phones and social media filled with pictures of a UFO; the Los Angeles Fire Department put out an advisory that the “mysterious light in the sky” was the launch, and Elon Musk posted the video as a “nuclear alien UFO from North Korea”. The launch had been announced in advance; twilight launches from Vandenberg have caused the same reports since.

**Explanation:** A scheduled Falcon 9 launch carrying ten Iridium NEXT satellites from Vandenberg; the exhaust plume, lit by the Sun after sunset on the ground, made the glowing cloud. The Los Angeles Fire Department issued an advisory that the light came from the launch.

Sources:
- [SpaceX — Iridium-4 press kit (copy at The Black Vault)](https://www.theblackvault.com/casefiles/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/iridium4presskit.pdf)

## Learjet and American 1095 over Arizona — “something just passed over us” (2018)

- Date: 24 February 2018 (time approximate)
- Place: Over southern Arizona, east of the Sonoran Desert National Monument (United States)
- Status: DISPUTED — Explanation proposed but contested
- Kind: Aviation encounter
- Evidence: Pilot / aircrew witnesses; Audio recording / radio transcript
- Shape: A bright, reflective object several thousand feet above the airliners
- Witnesses: The crew of a Phoenix Air Learjet 36 and of American Airlines Flight 1095, an Airbus A321; the Albuquerque Center controller
- Duration: About six minutes for both reports
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/arizona-learjet-2018/

On the afternoon of February 24, 2018, a Learjet 36 flying east at about 37,000 ft over southern Arizona asked Albuquerque Center whether anything had just passed over it; the controller had nothing, and the pilot said something had. The controller asked American Airlines Flight 1095, an Airbus A321 following on the same route, to watch for traffic above it within the next 15 miles; a few minutes later its crew reported that something had passed over them, two or three thousand feet higher, going the other way, and, asked whether it was moving or hovering, said it was very bright or reflective. Someone on the frequency suggested a Google balloon, which the airline crew doubted, and someone else called it a UFO. The FAA released the recording to reporters in March; it said the controller could not see any other aircraft and suggested a high-altitude balloon. Nothing more was published.

**Explanation:** An FAA spokesperson suggested a high-altitude balloon, which need not carry a transponder or tell air traffic control; the area sees regular research and weather balloons. The controller could not see anything on radar, and the pilots, who saw it pass above and in the opposite direction, did not sound convinced. No report of a military aircraft or drone in the area emerged.

Sources:
- [The War Zone — a Learjet and an Airbus encounter a mystery craft high over Arizona (with the FAA audio)](https://www.twz.com/19095/listen-in-as-a-learjet-and-an-airbus-encounter-a-mystery-craft-high-over-arizona)
- [CBS News — two airline pilots report seeing a UFO while flying over Arizona](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ufo-over-arizona-sighting-american-airlines-learjet-pilots-see-ufo/)

## Ireland — airline pilots report fast lights (2018)

- Date: 9 November 2018
- Place: Atlantic off County Kerry, Ireland
- Status: DISPUTED — Explanation proposed but contested
- Kind: Aviation encounter
- Evidence: Pilot / aircrew witnesses; Audio recording / radio transcript
- Shape: Very bright lights moving at high speed
- Witnesses: Crews of a British Airways and a Virgin Atlantic flight, and others
- Duration: Seconds
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/ireland-pilots-2018/

At about 6:47 on the morning of November 9, 2018 the pilot of a British Airways flight from Montreal to London radioed Shannon air traffic control to ask whether military exercises were under way. A “very bright light” had come up on the left of the aircraft and “rapidly veered to the north”, then disappeared at very high speed. The crew of a Virgin Atlantic flight reported two bright lights that banked to the right and climbed away at what the pilot called “astronomical” speed, “like Mach 2”. Controllers saw nothing on radar, and no military exercises were taking place. The Irish Aviation Authority said it would investigate by confidentially interviewing the pilots. More than one crew reported it, and the story was carried by news outlets around the world.

**Explanation:** One pilot suggested a meteor or an object in re-entry, and an astronomer at the Armagh Observatory said the lights were most likely meteors. Air traffic control saw nothing on radar and no military exercises were running, so nothing has been confirmed.

Sources:
- [Time — Irish authorities investigate UFO sightings by commercial pilots](https://time.com/5453027/ireland-ufo/)
- [CBS News — Pilots report seeing UFO “moving so fast” off the coast of Ireland](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pilots-report-seeing-ufo-sky-off-ireland-2018-11-12)
- [Euronews — UFO sightings reported by pilots over Ireland](https://www.euronews.com/2018/11/13/ufo-sightings-reported-by-pilots-over-ireland)

## USS Omaha sphere & USS Russell "pyramids" (2019)

- Date: 15 July 2019 (time approximate)
- Place: Off San Diego, California (International waters (off California))
- Status: DISPUTED — Explanation proposed but contested
- Kind: Military encounter
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Military witnesses; Radar tracking; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Spherical object descending into the sea; flashing pyramid shapes
- Witnesses: Crew of USS Omaha, USS Russell and other ships
- Duration: Several nights in July 2019
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/uss-omaha-russell-2019/

During July 2019, several Navy ships off Southern California reported drone-like objects around them at night. A CIC video from USS Omaha shows a sphere flying over the ocean and apparently descending into the water; night-vision footage from USS Russell shows blinking pyramid-shaped lights. Both leaked in 2021 and were confirmed as authentic Navy footage.

**Explanation:** The Pentagon confirmed the leaked clips were taken by Navy personnel. Analysts attribute the "pyramids" to the triangular aperture of a night-vision lens (bokeh) on aircraft/stars, and the Omaha sphere to a distant aircraft or balloon.

## Colorado and Nebraska drone swarms (2019)

- Date: 20 December 2019 (time approximate)
- Place: Phillips County and the plains of north-eastern Colorado (United States)
- Status: DISPUTED — Explanation proposed but contested
- Kind: Recurring lights
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Photographs; Many independent witnesses; Police witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Drones with a wingspan of about 6 ft and blinking lights, in groups of six to ten, flying grid patterns
- Witnesses: Ranchers, residents and county sheriff’s deputies
- Duration: About six weeks
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/colorado-drones-2019/

In December 2019, residents and deputies in north-eastern Colorado and western Nebraska began reporting drones with wingspans of about six feet flying in groups of six to ten, at 200 to 500 feet, in grid patterns across the plains, mostly between about 7 and 10 p.m.; one witness counted 19. County sheriffs asked the public for information, and more than 70 local, state and federal agencies met in Brush on January 6, 2020. The FAA said no drone company or test site had authorized flights there, and the Air Force, which had run counter-drone exercises at F. E. Warren AFB, would neither claim nor deny the drones. As the sightings spread, more and more turned out to be planets, stars and airliners, and the state ended its search later that month.

**Explanation:** State and federal agencies found that most reports were planets, stars, aircraft and hobby drones, and the Colorado Department of Public Safety stood its effort down in January 2020. The large, grid-flying drones of the first reports were never tied to an operator.

Sources:
- [Wikipedia — 2019–20 Colorado drone sightings](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019%E2%80%9320_Colorado_drone_sightings)
- [Colorado Public Radio — The FAA is now investigating Colorado’s mysterious drones (2019)](https://www.cpr.org/2019/12/31/the-faa-is-now-investigating-colorados-mysterious-drones-and-sen-cory-gardner-has-weighed-in-too/)
- [The War Zone — FAA documents on the Colorado drone mystery](https://www.twz.com/34662/faa-documents-offer-unprecedented-look-into-colorado-drone-mystery)

## Sendai’s white balloon (2020)

- Date: 17 June 2020 (time approximate)
- Place: Over Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Photographs; Video / film footage; Many independent witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: A large white sphere with crossed struts and propellers hanging beneath
- Witnesses: Residents of Sendai and Miyagi; the Sendai City Observatory photographed it
- Duration: Most of a day
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/sendai-balloon-2020/

On the morning of June 17, 2020, residents of northern Sendai began posting photographs of a large white sphere hanging almost motionless in the sky, with crossed struts and propellers beneath it. The Sendai office of the Japan Meteorological Agency said it looked like a weather balloon “but it’s not ours”, police sent a helicopter but could not identify it, Kyushu University denied it was theirs, and the government said only that it was aware of the object, which later drifted out over the Pacific. In February 2023, after the Chinese balloon crossed the United States, Japan’s Ministry of Defense re-examined the Sendai balloon and similar ones over Kagoshima in 2019 and Aomori in 2021, and concluded that they were strongly presumed to be Chinese unmanned reconnaissance balloons. It protested to Beijing, which said Japan had no proof.

**Explanation:** A balloon. On February 14, 2023, after the Chinese balloon was shot down over the United States, Japan’s Ministry of Defense said that the balloons seen over its territory in November 2019, June 2020 and September 2021 were “strongly presumed” to be unmanned reconnaissance balloons flown by China; China rejected the claim.

Sources:
- [Ministry of Defense of Japan — notice of February 14, 2023 on the balloons (in Japanese)](https://www.mod.go.jp/j/press/news/2023/02/14c.pdf)
- [The Aviationist — Japan says it strongly presumes China sent three spy balloons into its airspace (2023)](https://theaviationist.com/2023/02/15/japan-says-it-strongly-presumes-china-sent-three-spy-balloons-into-its-airspace/)
- [Inquirer / AFP — Mysterious “UFO” captures imaginations in Japan (2020)](https://technology.inquirer.net/101025/mysterious-ufo-captures-imaginations-in-japan)

## American Airlines 2292 — “cruise-missile type of thing” (2021)

- Date: 21 February 2021
- Place: Northeastern New Mexico, at about 36,000 ft (United States)
- Status: UNRESOLVED — No accepted explanation
- Kind: Aviation encounter
- Evidence: Pilot / aircrew witnesses; Audio recording / radio transcript
- Shape: Long cylinder, “almost like a cruise missile”
- Witnesses: The crew of American Airlines Flight 2292
- Duration: Seconds
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/aa2292-2021/

On February 21, 2021, at about 12:29 p.m. local time, the crew of American Airlines Flight 2292, an Airbus A320 flying from Cincinnati to Phoenix at about 36,000 feet over the north-east corner of New Mexico, radioed: “Do you have any targets up here? We just had something go right over the top of us. I hate to say this, but it looked like a long cylindrical object that almost looked like a cruise missile type of thing, moving really fast right over the top of us.” The transmission was recorded by Steve Douglass, a radio listener. American Airlines at first denied that it was authentic, then confirmed that it was from Flight 2292 after talking to the crew. The FAA said controllers saw nothing on radar, and the Pentagon said it had no tests in the area.

**Explanation:** No explanation has been given. The FAA said air traffic controllers saw no object on their radar. The Pentagon said the military was not conducting tests in the area that day, and the FBI said it was aware of the report.

Sources:
- [The War Zone — American Airlines confirms pilot report of cylinder-shaped object over New Mexico](https://www.twz.com/39416/american-airlines-confirms-pilot-report-of-bizarre-cylinder-shaped-object-over-new-mexico)

## Lights over Seattle and Portland — a Falcon 9 stage re-entering (2021)

- Date: 25 March 2021
- Place: Over western Oregon and Washington; debris in Grant County, Washington (United States)
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Tracked object event
- Evidence: Many independent witnesses; Video / film footage; Physical traces (ground marks, debris, soil); Official government document or case file
- Shape: A cluster of bright fragments with glowing trails, moving slowly across the sky
- Witnesses: Thousands of people in western Oregon and Washington
- Duration: About a minute
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/falcon9-reentry-2021/

At about 9 p.m. on March 25, 2021, people from Portland to Seattle saw a slow cluster of bright lights with trails cross the sky, breaking apart as it went, and posted videos of what many took for a meteor shower or a formation of craft. The National Weather Service office in Seattle said that night that the lights were the remnants of a Falcon 9 second stage re-entering; the astronomer Jonathan McDowell confirmed that the stage, left in orbit after a Starlink launch on March 4 when its de-orbit burn failed, had come down at about 04:00 UTC on March 26. Days later a farmer in Grant County, in central Washington, reported to the sheriff an object that had left a four-inch dent in his field: a composite-overwrapped pressure vessel from the stage, which SpaceX identified and collected. It is one of the few re-entries where the identification, the tracking and a piece of the object all came together.

**Explanation:** The second stage of a SpaceX Falcon 9 that launched Starlink satellites on March 4, 2021, failed to make its de-orbit burn and re-entered uncontrolled about three weeks later. The National Weather Service in Seattle identified the lights the same night, and a pressure vessel from the stage was found on a farm in Grant County, Washington, and recovered by SpaceX.

Sources:
- [The Aerospace Corporation — Falcon 9 R/B (ID 47782) reentered](https://aerospace.org/reentries/falcon-9-rb-id-47782)
- [Vice — a piece of a SpaceX rocket crash-landed on a farm in Washington](https://www.vice.com/en/article/a-piece-of-a-spacex-rocket-crash-landed-on-a-farm-in-washington/)

Shown by AARO at NASA’s UAP Independent Study Team public meeting (May 31, 2023) as an example of a resolved case: three unidentified infrared dots turned out to be three separate commercial aircraft at great distance.

## Maldonado — the UFO videos that were a festival campaign (2021)

- Date: 12 August 2021 (time approximate)
- Place: Parque del Jagüel, Punta del Este, Maldonado (Uruguay)
- Status: EXPLAINED — Mundane explanation widely accepted or officially assessed
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Not described; staged footage
- Witnesses: None independent; the footage was produced for an advertising campaign
- Duration: Not applicable
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/maldonado-promo-2021/

On August 12, 2021, videos circulated in Uruguay that appeared to show a UFO landing, U.S. aircraft and U.S. scientists at the Parque del Jagüel in Maldonado, with one clip presented as a breaking-news report by a well-known Subrayado journalist. The Uruguayan Air Force’s commission for UFO reports, CRIDOVNI, examined the material and announced the next day that, having investigated the evidence and analysed the possible events, they “are not real”. The clips turned out to be part of a promotional campaign for the America Rockstars music festival.

**Explanation:** The Uruguayan Air Force’s CRIDOVNI investigated and said the events “are not real”: the videos were part of a promotional campaign for the America Rockstars festival, including a staged television news flash.

Sources:

## AC-130J “cold orbs” over the Gulf of Oman (2021)

- Date: 8 September 2021 (time approximate)
- Place: Gulf of Oman (exact location withheld)
- Status: UNRESOLVED — No accepted explanation
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Infrared or other sensor data; Official government document or case file; Military witnesses
- Shape: “Cold orbs”, approximately four feet in diameter
- Witnesses: The crew of a U.S. Special Operations Forces AC-130J gunship
- Duration: Six clips of 2 to 34 seconds
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/gulf-of-oman-orbs-2021/

On September 8, 2021, the crew of a U.S. Special Operations AC-130J Ghostrider gunship over the Gulf of Oman tracked what an Intelligence Information Report (DOW-UAP-D101) calls “cold orbs” about four feet in diameter. U.S. Central Command sent AARO six short videos, recorded at the same time on a mobile phone pointed at the infrared sensor display. In most of them a small area of contrast stays in the centre of the sensor’s view; in two overlapping clips a larger and a smaller one cross the frame and come back. The Department of War released them as DOW-UAP-PR117 to PR122 in 2026, without a determination.

**Explanation:** AARO released the six clips in 2026 as unresolved. They are phone recordings of the gunship’s infrared display, not the sensor data itself, which limits what can be measured; the accompanying Intelligence Information Report describes “cold orbs” about four feet across.

Sources:
- [DVIDS — DOW-UAP-PR117, Unresolved UAP Report, Gulf of Oman, 2021](https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1017793)

## FBI files — orbs over one place in the north-eastern U.S. (2021)

- Date: 1 November 2021 (time approximate)
- Place: A sparsely populated place in the north-eastern United States (withheld)
- Status: UNASSESSED — Released without an official determination
- Kind: Recurring lights
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Official government document or case file; Many independent witnesses
- Shape: Bright lights splitting into several rotating points; red spheres; a “plasma-like” sphere over a pond; two red orbs moving together
- Witnesses: An eyewitness the FBI rates highly credible, and in 2025 a couple about 25 miles away
- Duration: Minutes to 45 minutes each, on four occasions between 2021 and 2025
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/fbi-northeast-orbs-2021/

Among the files the FBI released through the Department of War in 2026 are four phone videos from the same sparsely populated area of the north-eastern United States. In November 2021, at about 5 a.m., an eyewitness filmed a bright light near the horizon that resolved into several lights rotating erratically around each other. In March 2022 the same witness filmed two red lights, the lower turning slowly around the upper; in October 2024, a luminous “plasma-like” sphere that hung over a pond for about 45 minutes, shedding smaller points. In July 2025 a couple within 25 miles of those places saw a red sphere hovering 25 feet above their backyard, then a second above it; the two moved off together, silently, over the trees. The FBI calls the first witness highly credible and says the government authenticated the 2024 video; it does not say what the lights were.

**Explanation:** Released in 2026 with the witnesses’ statements and the FBI’s view that they are credible, but with no determination of what the lights were. The phone videos are short, shaky and distant.

Sources:

## The Navy’s night-vision image shown to Congress — drones (2022)

- Date: 1 January 2022 (time approximate)
- Place: Naval exercise areas off the U.S. East Coast (exact place and date withheld) (United States)
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Photographs; Military witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Points of light in a night-vision image
- Witnesses: Navy personnel during exercises
- Duration: —
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/east-coast-navy-uas-2022/

At the House Intelligence subcommittee’s open hearing on unidentified aerial phenomena on May 17, 2022, the first public congressional hearing on the subject in more than fifty years, the Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence, Scott Bray, showed an image taken through night-vision goggles with a single-lens reflex camera during Navy exercises off the East Coast in early 2022. Bray told the committee that, using information from other sightings, the Navy had reclassified the objects as unmanned aerial systems. He also showed an unresolved clip of a small sphere flashing past a Navy fighter’s cockpit. The image is in the Pentagon’s official release on DVIDS.

## The blue spiral over New Zealand — a Falcon 9 upper stage (2022)

- Date: 19 June 2022
- Place: Across New Zealand, photographed from Queenstown, Stewart Island and Motueka
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Photographs; Many independent witnesses
- Shape: A glowing blue-white spiral, growing as it moved across the sky
- Witnesses: Stargazers and residents across the South Island and beyond, including a tour operator on Stewart Island
- Duration: Several minutes
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/nz-spiral-2022/

At about 7:27 p.m. on Sunday, June 19, 2022, people across New Zealand saw a bright spiral of light appear and grow as it moved across the night sky. Alasdair Burns, a tour operator on Stewart Island, was alerted by text and photographed it; Clare Rehill photographed it above Queenstown, and an observer in Motueka posted that it was “just happening”. Photographs went round the world the next day. Astronomers quickly tied it to a Falcon 9 launched three hours earlier, whose second stage was passing over New Zealand while it vented fuel before its de-orbit burn.

**Explanation:** The upper stage of the SpaceX Falcon 9 that launched the Globalstar FM15 satellite from Cape Canaveral at 04:27 UTC that day, venting its leftover propellant before the burn that brought it down into the Pacific. The New Plymouth Astronomical Society and satellite observers matched the time; the same kind of spiral has followed other Falcon 9 launches.

Sources:
- [Space.com — Wild blue spiral in New Zealand sky likely made by SpaceX rocket](https://www.space.com/spacex-rocket-launch-blue-spiral-photo)
- [Newstalk ZB — Stargazers left in awe after spiral appears in night sky](https://www.newstalkzb.co.nz/news/science/stargazers-left-in-awe-after-spiral-appears-in-night-sky)
- [Spaceweather.com archive — Strange things in the sky, courtesy of SpaceX](https://spaceweatherarchive.com/2022/07/02/strange-things-in-the-sky-courtesy-of-spacex/)

## MQ-9 "Middle East orb" (2022)

Shown by AARO director Sean Kirkpatrick at the April 19, 2023 Senate Armed Services hearing: an MQ-9 Reaper’s sensor briefly tracks a silver orb crossing its field of view — typical of the many reports AARO receives with minimal data.

**Explanation:** AARO: the object did not show anomalous behaviour but remains unidentified for lack of data.

## Long March 5B core stage burns up over Sarawak (2022)

- Date: 31 July 2022
- Place: Over Sarawak, Malaysia, toward the Sulu Sea
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Tracked object event
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Many independent witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: A line of bright fragments, like a slow meteor shower
- Witnesses: Residents of Kuching and other parts of Sarawak who filmed it
- Duration: About a minute
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/long-march-5b-sarawak-2022/

Just before 1 a.m. on July 31, 2022, people in Kuching and elsewhere in Sarawak saw a slow procession of bright fragments cross the sky, which many took at first for a meteor shower, and filmed it on their phones. It was the core stage of the Long March 5B that had launched China’s Wentian laboratory module a week earlier. Unlike most rocket stages it had reached orbit, and its fall had been tracked and debated for days because China had not released trajectory details. The Malaysian Space Agency said the debris had crossed Malaysian airspace and fallen into the Sulu Sea; pieces were reported in Sarawak and West Kalimantan.

**Explanation:** The 21-tonne core stage of the Chinese Long March 5B rocket that launched the Wentian space-station module on July 24, 2022, falling back uncontrolled. The Malaysian Space Agency confirmed that its burning debris crossed Malaysian airspace, and the re-entry point was given as 9.1° N, 119.0° E, in the Sulu Sea.

Sources:
- [Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation — press clipping: MYSA on the debris crossing Malaysian airspace](https://www.mosti.gov.my//wp-content/uploads/repository/keratan_akhbar/2022/07%20-%20Julai%202022/31.07.2022_THE%20SARAWAK%20TRIBUNE_MYSA_Debris%20of%20China%27s%20rocket%20crossed%20Malaysia%27s%20airspace.pdf)
- [New Straits Times — Debris from Chinese rocket crosses Malaysian airspace](https://www.nst.com.my/amp/news/nation/2022/07/818065/debris-chinese-rocket-crosses-malaysian-airspace-nsttv)
- [The Vibes — Long March 5B debris sparks fiery re-entry off Sarawak’s coasts](https://www.thevibes.com/articles/news/67237/chinese-long-march-5b-rocket-debris-sparks-fiery-re-entry-off-sarawaks-coasts)

## Porto Alegre — airline pilots report blinking lights (2022)

- Date: 5 November 2022 (time approximate)
- Place: Approach to Salgado Filho airport, Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul (Brazil)
- Status: DISPUTED — Explanation proposed but contested
- Kind: Aviation encounter
- Evidence: Pilot / aircrew witnesses; Audio recording / radio transcript; Video / film footage; Many independent witnesses
- Shape: Lights switching on and off, one to three at a time, apparently stationary and higher than the aircraft
- Witnesses: Crews of LATAM 3406, Azul 4657 and other flights; the Porto Alegre tower
- Duration: Minutes, on several nights
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/porto-alegre-pilots-2022/

On the nights of November 4 and 5, 2022, crews approaching Porto Alegre reported lights in the sky to the controllers, and their radio exchanges were widely shared. The pilot of LATAM flight 3406 from São Paulo asked whether anyone had reported objects over the city and described lights that switched on and off, sometimes one and sometimes two or three; the pilot of Azul 4657 from Belo Horizonte said he had seen them since leaving Minas Gerais and that they were well above his 38,000 ft. The tower said it could see them too, apparently stationary, and that they would not affect approaches; similar reports came from over Santa Catarina in late October and from four aircraft on November 8. The Air Force said its radars detected no unknown object. Astronomers suggested Starlink satellites catching the sun, searchlights on cloud and, for some videos, meteors; none was confirmed for the pilots’ sightings.

**Explanation:** Astronomers proposed several ordinary causes: sunlight flashing off Starlink satellites (an analysis of a video from Torres pointed to Starlink “almost 100%”), searchlights reflected by cloud, and meteors in other recordings. The Brazilian Air Force said its radars detected nothing unknown, and no single cause was confirmed for the pilots’ reports.

Sources:

## MQ-9 records object with "wake" — South Asia (2023)

- Date: 15 January 2023 (time approximate)
- Place: South Asia (exact location withheld)
- Status: EXPLAINED — Mundane explanation widely accepted or officially assessed
- Kind: Photo / video case

An MQ-9 filming another MQ-9 caught an object with an apparent wake crossing the frame. AARO showed it at the April 2023 Senate hearing and released both clips.

**Explanation:** AARO resolved the case in February 2024 (“Atmospheric Wakes”): frame-by-frame analysis and flight data showed a commuter aircraft flying near the two MQ-9s, and the apparent wake was the heat signature from its engines.

## AARO’s “Eglin UAP” — a lighting balloon (2023)

- Date: 26 January 2023 (time approximate)
- Place: Eglin Air Force Base training range, over the Gulf off north-west Florida (United States)
- Status: EXPLAINED — Mundane explanation widely accepted or officially assessed
- Kind: Military encounter
- Evidence: Radar tracking; Infrared or other sensor data; Photographs; Pilot / aircrew witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: About 12 ft across: a rounded grey lower half and a cone on top, like an Apollo capsule
- Witnesses: A military pilot
- Duration: Minutes
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/eglin-balloon-2023/

On January 26, 2023, a military pilot training over the Eglin range off Florida saw four objects on radar at 16,000 to 18,000 ft, apparently in formation. Only one was seen: about 12 ft across, grey and paneled, rounded below and cone-shaped above “like the Apollo spacecraft”, with an orange-red patch at its centre and “blurry air” beneath; the pilot later thought a vertical engine was attached to its side. The aircraft’s video recorder was out of service, so the infrared and visual sensor took two still images. When the jet closed to within 4,000 ft its radar failed, and the object sank into the clouds. AARO found that the circuit breaker had tripped on the same aircraft three times before, that the images matched a commercial lighting balloon with black and white halves, which it tested, and that the object moved with the wind at that height. It closed the case in October 2023 as very likely a balloon.

**Explanation:** AARO assessed with moderate confidence that it was a lighter-than-air object, such as a large commercial lighting balloon, a weather balloon or a large Mylar balloon, drifting with the wind; its intelligence and science-and-technology partners independently reached the same conclusion with high confidence. The radar failure was a circuit breaker that had tripped three times before.

Sources:
- [AARO case resolution, “Eglin UAP” (copy at The Black Vault)](https://documents2.theblackvault.com/documents/osd/Case_Resolution_of_Eglin_UAP_2_508_.pdf)
- [The War Zone — Eglin AFB pilot likely saw a lighting balloon, not a UFO, Pentagon concludes (2024)](https://www.twz.com/air/eglin-afb-pilot-likely-saw-a-lighting-balloon-not-a-ufo-pentagon-concludes)
- [The Debrief — AARO has only moderate confidence in its latest findings (2024)](https://thedebrief.org/aaro-has-only-moderate-confidence-in-findings-from-its-latest-uap-investigation-its-easy-to-see-why/)

## Chinese surveillance balloon (2023)

- Date: 28 January 2023 (time approximate)
- Place: Aleutians → Montana → Carolina coast (United States / Canada)
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Tracked object event
- Evidence: Photographs; Video / film footage; Radar tracking; Official government document or case file; Physical traces (ground marks, debris, soil)
- Shape: Large white balloon with solar-array payload
- Witnesses: Millions; NORAD tracking
- Duration: 8 days
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/chinese-balloon-2023/

A high-altitude balloon from China crossed into U.S. airspace north of the Aleutians, drifted over Canada, passed over Malmstrom AFB in Montana and across the continent before being shot down off South Carolina. The event prompted NORAD to re-tune its radars, which led to the February 10–12 shoot-downs of three smaller unidentified objects.

**Explanation:** A PRC high-altitude surveillance balloon; shot down by an F-22 AIM-9X off Surfside Beach, South Carolina, and recovered by the U.S. Navy.

## The balloon over Colombia — China’s second airship (2023)

- Date: 3 February 2023 (time approximate)
- Place: Northern Colombian airspace; also reported over Costa Rica and on towards Venezuela
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Tracked object event
- Evidence: Radar tracking; Official government document or case file
- Shape: An object with the characteristics of a balloon
- Witnesses: Colombia’s national air-defence system; Costa Rican authorities
- Duration: Until it left Colombian airspace
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/colombia-balloon-2023/

On the morning of Friday, February 3, 2023, the day the first Chinese balloon was crossing the United States, Colombia’s air-defence system detected an object “with characteristics similar to those of a balloon” in the north of the country at about 55,000 ft, moving at an average of 25 knots. The Colombian Air Force followed it until it left national airspace, said it posed no threat to national security or to aviation, and began working with other countries to establish its origin. Costa Rica also reported a balloon. The Pentagon said the same day that another suspected Chinese balloon was over Latin America, and later that these balloons were part of a fleet built for surveillance. On February 6 China confirmed the balloon was its own, calling it a civilian airship that, affected by the weather and with limited self-steering, had drifted into Latin American and Caribbean airspace.

**Explanation:** The Pentagon identified it as a second Chinese surveillance balloon; China said it was a civilian airship for flight tests that had strayed far off course because of the weather and its limited steering.

Sources:
- [Gulf Times / AFP — Colombia says object spotted overhead after Chinese balloon warning](https://www.gulf-times.com/article/654893/international/uslatin-america/colombia-says-object-spotted-overhead-after-chinese-balloon-warning)
- [Boston Globe — another Chinese balloon flew over Latin America, China confirms](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2023/02/06/world/another-chinese-balloon-flew-over-latin-america-china-confirms/)

## February 2023 shoot-downs (Alaska, Yukon, Lake Huron) (2023)

- Date: 10 February 2023
- Place: Deadhorse AK · Yukon · Lake Huron (United States / Canada)
- Status: UNRESOLVED — No accepted explanation
- Kind: Tracked object event
- Evidence: Radar tracking; Video / film footage; Pilot / aircrew witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Small octagonal / cylindrical objects at 20,000–40,000 ft
- Witnesses: NORAD; F-22 and F-16 pilots
- Duration: 3 days
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/north-american-shootdowns-2023/

After re-tuning radars following the Chinese balloon, NORAD detected and shot down three small objects in three days: off Deadhorse, Alaska (Feb 10), over central Yukon (Feb 11) and over Lake Huron (Feb 12). The first AIM-9X fired at the Lake Huron object missed. Debris was never recovered.

**Explanation:** The White House said the three objects were most likely benign commercial or research balloons; none was recovered. An infrared video of the Lake Huron shoot-down was released in 2026 as DOW-UAP-PR071.

## Las Vegas backyard “landing” (2023)

- Date: 30 April 2023
- Place: North-west Las Vegas valley, Nevada (United States)
- Status: DISPUTED — Explanation proposed but contested
- Kind: Close encounter
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Police witnesses; Audio recording / radio transcript
- Shape: A green flash streaking low across the sky; the family described tall beings with big eyes
- Witnesses: A police officer’s body camera; a family who called 911; skywatchers in four states
- Duration: Seconds (the flash); about an hour in all
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/las-vegas-backyard-2023/

At about 11:50 p.m. on April 30, 2023, a Las Vegas Metropolitan Police officer’s body camera caught a bright light streaking low across the night sky, and people across Nevada, eastern California, Arizona and Utah reported a green fireball to the American Meteor Society. About 40 minutes later a man called 911 to say that something had fallen into his backyard in the north-west of the valley and that there were two tall beings “100 percent not human” in it. Officers came, found nothing and closed the call as unfounded; the release of the bodycam footage in June made the story famous, and later drone footage of a circular mark in the dirt was offered as evidence. NASA’s planetary defense office said the light was “certainly” a meteor, less than a metre across.

**Explanation:** The flash was a bright meteor, according to NASA’s planetary defense office and reports to the American Meteor Society from four states. Nothing supports the “beings”: the police found nothing and closed the call as unfounded.

Sources:
- [Vice — Did aliens land in Las Vegas? NASA says no (2023)](https://www.vice.com/en/article/93kknv/nasa-las-vegas-ufo-crash-meteor)
- [8 News Now — Las Vegas family claims to see aliens after several report something falling from sky (2023)](https://www.8newsnow.com/investigators/las-vegas-family-claims-to-see-aliens-after-several-report-something-falling-from-sky/)

## Espora naval air base — the “battle” that the Navy denied (2023)

- Date: 5 September 2023 (time approximate)
- Place: Base Aeronaval Comandante Espora, Bahía Blanca, Buenos Aires province (Argentina)
- Status: EXPLAINED — Mundane explanation widely accepted or officially assessed
- Kind: Military encounter
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Audio recording / radio transcript; Many independent witnesses
- Shape: Claimed: four black triangles
- Witnesses: Neighbours who called the police about bangs; a private UFO group’s unnamed sources
- Duration: An evening
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/espora-2023/

After 9 p.m. on September 5, 2023, residents near the Comandante Espora naval air base outside Bahía Blanca posted videos and called 911 about what they took for gunfire and explosions from the base, with a helicopter overhead. A private group, CEFORA, then claimed that four black triangular objects had flown over and landed at parts of the base, that personnel had fired on them, and that a laser from one had injured two or three soldiers; the story spread with memes across Argentina. Official sources at the base said the videos and audio were edited and that “the noises and images do not correspond to the place”, that there had been no exercise or shooting and nobody had seen anything, and that a helicopter had flown a scheduled routine patrol on its usual route. The police confirmed the calls, but no injury, damage or other record of an engagement ever appeared.

**Explanation:** Base sources said the circulating videos and audio were edited and did not come from the base, that no exercise or shooting took place and that staff saw nothing; the only activity was a helicopter on a scheduled routine patrol. The claims of triangular craft and a laser that wounded soldiers came from a private UFO group and were never supported by any record.

Sources:
- [C5N — the official explanation of the shots and explosions in Bahía Blanca](https://www.c5n.com/sociedad/enfrentamiento-ovnis-la-explicacion-oficial-los-disparos-y-explosiones-bahia-blanca-n126343)
- [Minuto Uno — UFOs in Bahía Blanca: the official explanation](https://www.minutouno.com/sociedad/ovnis/bahia-blanca-la-explicacion-oficial-los-disparos-y-las-explosiones-n5817935)

## The “Nazca mummies” shown to Mexico’s Congress (2023)

- Date: 12 September 2023 (time approximate)
- Place: Chamber of Deputies, San Lázaro, Mexico City (the figures came from the Nazca area of Peru) (Mexico / Peru)
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Landing / trace case
- Evidence: Physical traces (ground marks, debris, soil); Official government document or case file; Video / film footage
- Shape: Small three-fingered humanoid bodies
- Witnesses: Members of Mexico’s Chamber of Deputies; the presenter Jaime Maussan
- Duration: A congressional hearing
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/nazca-mummies-2023/

On September 12, 2023, at a hearing on unidentified phenomena in Mexico’s Chamber of Deputies, the journalist and UFO promoter Jaime Maussan unveiled two small, three-fingered bodies in glass cases, said they came from the Nazca region of Peru, were over 700 years old and were “non-human beings”, and cited studies at the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM), whose scientists denied that the university had endorsed any such conclusion. Mexico’s Congress took no position. Maussan had promoted similar bodies from Peru in 2017, which Peruvian officials then called recently manufactured dolls. In October 2023 Peruvian customs seized two more figures bound for a buyer in Mexico, and in January 2024 forensic archaeologist Flavio Estrada presented the analysis at Peru’s Ministry of Culture: the figures were dolls built from human and animal bones glued with modern adhesive, “not extraterrestrials”.

**Explanation:** Forensic specialists working for Peru’s prosecutors and Ministry of Culture examined seized figures and found them to be three-fingered dolls assembled from human and animal bones held together with modern glue; similar bodies promoted in 2017 had already been found to be recently made.

Sources:
- [CBS News — “Aliens” found in Peru are actually dolls made of bones, forensic experts declare](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/peru-dolls-are-not-aliens-forensic-experts-say/)
- [404 Media — the Mexican Congress alien mummies, explained](https://www.404media.co/mexican-congress-alien-mummies-explained/)

## Langley Air Force Base drone incursions (2023)

- Date: 6 December 2023 (time approximate)
- Place: Joint Base Langley-Eustis, Hampton, Virginia (United States)
- Status: UNRESOLVED — No accepted explanation
- Kind: Military encounter
- Evidence: Military witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Drones of several sizes; the first reportedly about 20 ft long
- Witnesses: Base personnel and U.S. military officials
- Duration: Seventeen days
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/langley-drones-2023/

From the evening of December 6, 2023, unauthorized drones flew over Langley Air Force Base, home of F-22 Raptor squadrons, across Hampton Roads from the Navy’s largest base at Norfolk, on and off for 17 days. The Wall Street Journal later reported that they typically arrived 45 minutes to an hour after sunset, that the first was about 20 feet long and flew at 3,000 to 4,000 feet, and that a dozen or more smaller drones followed. The Pentagon confirmed the incursions in October 2024. Gen. Glen VanHerck, who led NORAD at the time, later said the military had warned for years that it was not ready for this threat; he gave no new details about who was operating the drones.

**Explanation:** The Pentagon confirmed the incursions in October 2024 and said the drones did not appear to show hostile intent, but neither it nor NORAD has said who flew them.

Sources:
- [WHRO — The Pentagon confirmed a swarm of drones violated Langley airspace (2024)](https://www.whro.org/military-veterans/2024-10-15/the-pentagon-confirmed-a-swarm-of-drones-violated-langley-airspace)

## The “plume” over Buenos Aires — a Chinese rocket identified (2024)

- Date: 8 May 2024
- Place: Castelar, Buenos Aires province; also seen from Entre Ríos, Uruguay, Chile, Bolivia and Paraguay (Argentina)
- Status: IDENTIFIED — Object positively identified
- Kind: Tracked object event
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Many independent witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: A glowing plume in an inverted V, rising across the sky
- Witnesses: A witness in Castelar who filmed it for 40 minutes; many observers across five countries
- Duration: About 40 minutes
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/castelar-long-march-2024/

At about 11:30 p.m. on May 8, 2024, a man in Castelar, west of Buenos Aires, filmed a glowing, feather-shaped plume climbing across the sky for some forty minutes until it was almost overhead, and sent the video to the Argentine Air Force’s aerospace identification centre (CIAE). The same sight was reported that night from several Argentine provinces and from Paysandú in Uruguay, Valparaíso in Chile, Bolivia and Paraguay. The CIAE recognised the inverted-V pattern left by a rocket’s upper stage and found a Long March 3B/E that had lifted off from Xichang at 01:43 UTC on May 9 (22:43 in Argentina) with the Smart SkyNet 1-01 satellite. Rebuilding the ascent from its trajectory, it found the rocket over the South Pacific about 3,600 km up, heading north-east into the sector of sky the camera was pointing at, 47 minutes after launch. In its 2024 report the centre classed the case as definitely explained, like all 36 cases it analysed that year.

**Explanation:** Argentina’s Air Force identification centre (CIAE) matched the video, by the rocket’s ascent trajectory, to the exhaust plume of the Long March 3B/E launched 47 minutes earlier from Xichang, China, with the Smart SkyNet 1-01 satellite (NORAD catalogue number 59707); it classed the case “definitely explained”.

Sources:
- [Fuerza Aérea Argentina, CIAE — annual report 2024 (case 14, Castelar)](https://www.argentina.gob.ar/sites/default/files/2018/11/informe-ciae-2024.pdf)
- [El Entre Ríos — remains of a Chinese rocket seen from the Uruguay river coast](https://www.elentrerios.com/actualidad/restos-de-un-cohete-chino-fueron-avistados-desde-la-costa-del-ro-uruguay.htm)
- [Meganoticias — the strange object seen in the night sky over Valparaíso](https://www.meganoticias.cl/nacional/447058-que-es-extrano-objeto-avistado-cielo-nocturno-region-valparaiso-brk-9-5-2024.html)

In June 2024 an infrared sensor aboard a U.S. military platform recorded 21 seconds of an object that looks like an inverted teardrop with a straight vertical mass hanging beneath it, held in the centre of the field of view throughout. The video was reported to AARO and released on DVIDS in May 2026 as DOW-UAP-PR29, without a determination.
