## The “misshapen ball of white light” over Syria (2024)

- Date: 1 October 2024 (time approximate)
- Place: Syria (exact location withheld)
- Status: UNRESOLVED — No accepted explanation
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Official government document or case file
- Shape: A “misshapen and uneven ball of white light”, with white, red and orange patches on the video
- Witnesses: The crew of a U.S. military platform over Syria
- Duration: Three clips of five or six seconds
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/syria-white-light-2024/

In October 2024 a full-motion video camera aboard a U.S. military platform over Syria recorded what the mission report (DoW-UAP-D32) calls a “misshapen and uneven ball of white light”, adding that a “light/glare halo effect” appeared at the top of the feed. U.S. Central Command sent AARO three clips: in one an indistinct multi-coloured patch crosses the top edge of the display within a second; in another a half-oval of white and red highlights sits at the top edge; in the third two semi-transparent orange shapes overlay the picture for under two seconds each. They were released in May 2026 as DOW-UAP-PR31 to PR33.

**Explanation:** AARO released the three clips in 2026 as unresolved. The mission report itself notes a “light/glare halo effect” at the top of the video feed, and the clips last five or six seconds each, so an optical artefact cannot be excluded.

## The Yemen orb and the Hellfire — shown to Congress (2024)

- Date: 30 October 2024 (time approximate)
- Place: Off the coast of Yemen (exact location not released) (Waters off Yemen)
- Status: UNRESOLVED — No accepted explanation
- Kind: Military encounter
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Infrared or other sensor data
- Shape: A bright orb, at moments more cylindrical, moving on a steady course
- Witnesses: MQ-9 Reaper crews (sensor video)
- Duration: About 50 seconds of video
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/yemen-hellfire-2024/

At a House Oversight hearing on UAP transparency on September 9, 2025, Rep. Eric Burlison showed a 50-second infrared clip he said came from a whistleblower and was taken on October 30, 2024 off the coast of Yemen. An MQ-9 Reaper tracks, and appears to laser-designate, a bright object moving on a steady path; a Hellfire missile fired by a second Reaper streaks in, appears to hit it and throw off fragments, and glances away without exploding, while the object carries on until the clip ends. Burlison would not speculate on what it was and said an independent review was under way; a defense official told The War Zone, “We do not have anything to provide on this.” The clip was also a rare public sign that Reapers were engaging aerial targets during the Houthi attacks on shipping.

**Explanation:** Unverified: the clip came from a whistleblower and the Pentagon has said nothing about it. Analysts suggested a Houthi cruise missile or drone, or a balloon, and noted that a Hellfire without a proximity fuse can pass through a light target without exploding.

## New Jersey drone sightings (2024)

- Date: 18 November 2024 (time approximate)
- Place: Morris County, New Jersey, and the Northeast (United States)
- Status: EXPLAINED — Mundane explanation widely accepted or officially assessed
- Kind: Recurring lights
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Photographs; Many independent witnesses; Police witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Large lighted drones; many reports were aircraft
- Witnesses: Thousands of residents, police, state officials
- Duration: About six weeks
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/new-jersey-drones-2024/

From mid-November 2024, residents in Morris County reported large, lighted drones flying at night, including over Picatinny Arsenal and near the president-elect's golf club in Bedminster. Reports spread across New Jersey and into New York, Pennsylvania and beyond. The FAA placed temporary flight restrictions over dozens of sites. Stewart International Airport briefly closed its runways, and many viral videos turned out to show airliners.

**Explanation:** A joint FBI, DHS, FAA and DoD review found a mix of lawful commercial, hobbyist and law-enforcement drones, crewed aircraft and stars, with no threat to national security. In January 2025 the White House said the drones over New Jersey had been authorized by the FAA for research and other purposes.

## Drones over the U.S. air bases in England (2024)

- Date: 20 November 2024 (time approximate)
- Place: RAF Lakenheath, Mildenhall, Feltwell and Fairford, England (United Kingdom)
- Status: UNRESOLVED — No accepted explanation
- Kind: Military encounter
- Evidence: Military witnesses; Official government document or case file
- Shape: Small drones of varying number and type
- Witnesses: U.S. Air Force personnel; residents of nearby villages
- Duration: About a week
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/uk-airbase-drones-2024/

Between November 20 and 26, 2024, small drones were seen over and around four bases in England used by the U.S. Air Force: RAF Lakenheath, home of the 48th Fighter Wing, RAF Mildenhall, RAF Feltwell and RAF Fairford. The Air Force said “small unmanned aerial systems were spotted in the vicinity of and over RAF Lakenheath, RAF Mildenhall and RAF Feltwell between 20 and 22 November”. Air traffic into Mildenhall was disrupted: on November 21 a KC-46 tanker that had brought F-35s across the Atlantic turned back and diverted to Prestwick. British troops with counter-drone equipment were sent to help, and the Ministry of Defence Police opened an inquiry. Similar reports came from U.S. bases in Germany that December.

**Explanation:** The U.S. Air Force and the Ministry of Defence confirmed the drones, and the Ministry of Defence Police opened an investigation, but the operators were not identified.

Sources:
- [Air Force Times — Drones spotted near bases used by the US Air Force in England (2024)](https://www.airforcetimes.com/news/your-air-force/2024/11/25/drones-spotted-near-3-bases-used-by-us-air-force-in-england/)
- [Military Times — Criminal probe launched after US Air Force spots drones over UK bases (2024)](https://www.militarytimes.com/news/your-military/2024/11/27/criminal-probe-launched-after-us-air-force-spots-drones-over-uk-bases/)
- [The Aviationist — Unauthorised drones continue to plague U.S. Air Force bases in the UK](https://theaviationist.com/2024/11/27/unauthorised-drones-continue-to-plague-u-s-air-force-bases-in-the-uk/)
- [Wikipedia — 2024 drone sightings, United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_drone_sightings#United_Kingdom)

## Campo Largo — an influencer’s lights traced to a campsite (2026)

- Date: 31 May 2026 (time approximate)
- Place: Rural Campo Largo, Paraná (Brazil)
- Status: EXPLAINED — Mundane explanation widely accepted or officially assessed
- Kind: Photo / video case
- Evidence: Video / film footage; Audio recording / radio transcript; Official government document or case file
- Shape: A ring of lights alternating in brightness above the trees
- Witnesses: The influencer Mayk Leão, alone on his farm
- Duration: Twenty to forty minutes
- Page: https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/case/campo-largo-2026/

On May 31, 2026, Mayk Leão, a nursing technician and social-media influencer who lives alone on a remote farm in Campo Largo, Paraná, said his animals had been agitated, an electric fence was knocked down and he had heard metallic clicks, roars and mechanical noises; that evening he filmed bright lights in a circular group over a forested valley several kilometres away for twenty to forty minutes, and later drew a second, larger object he said passed over the property. His live streams and videos reached millions within days and drew national coverage. The Brazilian Air Force’s airspace department said its radars detected no unknown object, and internet users compared the sounds with a film trailer. Working from the coordinates of the farm, an image analyst then showed that the lights matched an escarpment beside a campsite, Chácara Paraíso, about 10 km away, whose lights are switched off when it has no guests.

**Explanation:** An image analyst who worked from the filming position showed the lights came from an escarpment by a campsite, Chácara Paraíso, about 10 km away, distorted by distance and the air; the campsite’s lights are off when it is empty, which is why they were not seen every night. The Brazilian Air Force said its air-defence radars detected nothing unusual.

Sources:
- [Folha (F5) — the Air Force contradicts the influencer and says it detected no UFO](https://f5.folha.uol.com.br/voceviu/2026/06/fab-contradiz-influenciador-e-diz-nao-ter-detectado-suposto-ovni-visto-no-parana.shtml)
- [g1 Paraná — influencer films strange lights (June 2, 2026)](https://g1.globo.com/pr/parana/noticia/2026/06/02/influencer-filmagem-luzes-estranhas-parana.ghtml)
- [Jundiaí Agora — analysis tracing the lights to the campsite](https://jundiagora.com.br/campo-4/)
